messages:
Lina S.: Heads up — since the egress policy change last night, a subset of edge pods in ap-southeast-1 are failing external fetches (pip/apt/artifact-store). noticeable increase in 5xx on outbound requests. anyone seen this?
Raj P.: seeing same from our sidecars. Envoy showing upstream reset / 503 for external clusters. happened ~23:10 UTC.
Maria K.: egress-gateway logs show Istio denying connection: "destination service not found" for hosts like pypi.example.com and artifacts.prod.internal.
Raj P.: tcpdump from host looks fine — SYN/ACK to egress-gw IP then immediate RST. not NAT exhaustion.
ops-bot: deploy: mesh/egress-policy v2 applied by @Maria K. — 2026-03-17T23:08:53Z
James (devex): quick theory: mesh outbound policy changed to REGISTRY_ONLY earlier and newly added AuthorizationPolicy on egress-gateway is too strict. If outboundTrafficPolicy.mode == REGISTRY_ONLY, sidecars will block unknown hosts unless ServiceEntry exists.
SRE Lead: can we confirm mesh config? run `kubectl -n istio-system get configmap istio -o yaml` or `istioctl proxy-config cluster <pod>` to see what Envoy knows.
Raj P.: ran `istioctl proxy-config cluster <edge-pod>` — no cluster for `pypi.example.com:443`. that's why Envoy 503s.
Maria K.: confirmed: we pushed an AuthorizationPolicy to egress-gateway to lock down external egress, but forgot to add ServiceEntries for public registries. my bad.
Lina S.: rough impact: model prewarm jobs fail to download wheels -> cascading cold starts on dedicated GPUs. hitting our latency & cost.
James (devex): temporary mitigation: 1) set `meshConfig.outboundTrafficPolicy.mode: ALLOW_ANY` (global) OR 2) create ServiceEntry for the specific hosts and ports + DestinationRule if TLS origination needed. Prefer 2 for security.
SRE Lead: agreed. don't want ALLOW_ANY long term. let's add ServiceEntry for pypi/artifact-store + explicit IP ranges for cloud providers.
Maria K.: creating ServiceEntry now for `pypi.example.com` with TLS passthrough. snippet: ```yaml
apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1beta1
kind: ServiceEntry
metadata:
  name: allow-pypi-external
spec:
  hosts:
  - "pypi.example.com"
  ports:
  - number: 443
    name: https
    protocol: TLS
  resolution: DNS
  location: MESH_EXTERNAL
```
Raj P.: also FYI some hosts use HTTP/2, Envoy config needs to allow h2 for those clusters otherwise we see 421/stream errors. check `protocol: HTTP2` in ServiceEntry ports if needed.
Lina S.: timeline: Maria created the ServiceEntry at 23:22 UTC. can folks validate traffic now?
Raj P.: quick smoke — downloads succeed from 3/3 pods now. no 503s.
Maria K.: follow-ups: will add ServiceEntry docs to the infra runbook, and open a small PR to make egress-gateway AuthorizationPolicy apply only to known-business hosts, not platform registries.
James (devex): long-term: add an eval to CI that runs a small external fetch from each region after mesh policy changes. catches these regressions early.
SRE Lead: +1 to CI check. also add alert when Envoy cluster_missing hits > 1% across pods.
Lina S.: thanks all — leaving this thread for the postmortem notes. :thumbsup:
